content_fields.title: Test if unnecessary host resources are exposed (Docker)
content_fields.description: Stop bind-mounting the host source tree into the running container.
content_fields.finding: The host source tree is bind-mounted read-write into the container at /app.
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
  web:
    build: .
    # no host bind mount; the image already contains ./app
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=64m,mode=1777
# Keep the bind mount only in a separate docker-compose.override.yml used for
# local development, which is not deployed.
criteria: The deployed compose file mounts no host path into the container.
Writable paths are explicit tmpfs mounts with size limits.
